title: Ordered Affine Composition
statement:
Use an iterative segment tree for point updates and ordered composition of affine functions. Function i maps x to ai·x+bi modulo m.

Input
n q m, then n lines a b. SET i a b replaces one function. APPLY L R x applies functions L through R to x, in increasing index order. Indices are 1-based and ranges inclusive.

Output
Print one residue for each APPLY, in input order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000. 1 ≤ m ≤ 10⁹+7. All coefficients and input x lie in [0,m−1].
